note: Conceptual/architecture lesson on compliance NFRs, Salesforce's published certifications, and translating a regulation into an architectural constraint using GDPR and HIPAA as examples. No screenshots per this course's conceptual/architecture policy. Salesforce's certification list (SOC 2/3, ISO 27001, FedRAMP Moderate for Government Cloud, HITRUST-based HIPAA support, ISO 27017/27018) was verified against compliance.salesforce.com before being stated; GDPR Article 17's right-to-erasure language was verified against the regulation's own text. The lesson deliberately frames HIPAA as a BAA-based obligation rather than a vendor certification, per what the trust portal itself describes.
